summary: Switching the settings language to English changed nothing: app/static/i18n.js and the language packs were never loaded by any page, and nothing read the saved language. New app/language.py reads `language` from the data directory's settings.json (anything missing or invalid means Chinese); the server resolves that directory with the same rule as the app (data_dir(root)) without building an App per request. The server injects /i18n/current.js and /i18n.js right after <head> of every page; /i18n/current.js carries the English pack (app/static/i18n/en-US.json, 642 entries keyed by the Chinese source text) only when English is chosen, escapes '</', and falls back to Chinese when the pack is unreadable. i18n.js translates rendered text nodes, title/placeholder/aria-label/alt and alert/confirm/prompt by exact key, part by part for ' · ' lists, or by '{0}' pattern keys. A slot next to a counter word or after 第/共 takes only a number; a Chinese capture is translated only as a whole (a pack entry, a list of them, or another pattern sentence under the same rules, depth-bounded) and is otherwise kept verbatim; a capture glued to the key's own Chinese rejects the pattern; a pattern that is not itself a list never swallows one; plural forms are chosen before named slots are filled. Titles, abstracts, AI summary text, quoted text, user questions, AI answers and selection translations are marked data-no-i18n, the knowledge base's title/abstract/note containers are skipped, and model follow-up questions are swapped only on an exact pack match. Text fields keep the user's text but get translated hints. Server-written prose (recommendation reasons, local guidance, pool shortfall, weekly analysis, suggestion names and reasons) has English branches with singular/plural forms. In English, paper_qa uses an English system prompt and daily_triage/project_guidance get one sentence asking for English output (placed before the profile and candidate text in triage); the Chinese prompts are byte-identical. scripts/i18n_extract.py lists every Chinese UI string statically, and a test requires an English entry for each. The unused legacy zh-CN.json pack is deleted. Independent review round 1 failed (half-translation, data-dir mismatch, plurals, directive order, head regex, vision prompt doc); round 2 confirmed five fixed and found nested pattern sentences still half-translated; round 3 passed the nested fix, and its three minor notes (glue guard for nested sentences, risk wording, stale HANDOFF) were addressed afterwards without another review.

budget_impact.rationale: No registry change and no new model call. The interface language layer is zero-token and offline. Only in English, paper_qa, daily_triage and project_guidance append one fixed sentence asking for English output (about 45 CJK characters; estimated 40-60 tokens, not measured), inside each operation's registered instructions component; paper_qa's English system prompt replaces, not adds to, the Chinese one. Caps, attempts and the single gateway are unchanged; English answers may differ in output length (not measured), still bounded by the registered output caps.
budget_impact.before: Chinese prompts only; English setting had no effect.
budget_impact.after: Chinese prompts byte-identical; English adds one sentence per call to three operations, within registered caps.
budget_impact.developer_usage: No paid calls. The preview data directory holds a live key, so /api/qa and /api/translate were intercepted in the page; all other checks are local.

quantified.period: one paper_qa call at the registered cap, peak cache-miss price (4200 x $0.30/M + 1100 x $1.20/M); arithmetic from harness/budget.json, not a measurement; the cap is unchanged

checks.note: Run in the owner's terminal because the agent sandbox blocks localhost binds; the evidence file also records the node tests.

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; English preview audit of home, detail, reader (quote card, stubbed /api/qa), knowledge base, profile and settings with misses() listing only user data, then back to Chinese unchanged.

Separate read-only code-review subagents with no part in the implementation; no model calls. Round 1 FAIL (half-translation, data-dir mismatch, plurals, directive after untrusted text, head regex, vision prompt doc). Round 2 FAIL (five fixed; nested pattern sentences half-translated). Round 3 PASS on the real pack with bounded runtime; three minor notes fixed afterwards and covered by tests, not re-reviewed.

open_risks: No live English request has been sent: whether the model answers in English reliably is unmeasured.

User data stays as stored: Chinese project and category names, cached Chinese AI summaries, AI text and paper text are not translated; the knowledge base's '暂无摘要' fallback sits inside a skipped container and stays Chinese.
User text (a project, category or pinned-keyword name) that equals a pack key, such as 收藏, or is shaped like a pattern sentence, such as 来源：arXiv or 有用 3, is translated in English mode.
A new UI string without a pack entry stays Chinese; the coverage test catches strings in the scanned files, not text built at runtime from fragments.
The DOM walk is checked by static markup assertions and the Chromium preview, not by an automated DOM test; the .app WKWebView needs the owner's look after switching the language.
